criteria.name: same_origin_application_shell
criteria.description:
Load the application over HTTP and require a substantive Brickfall page from
`localhost:3000`. Browser network evidence must show a successful same-origin
document response and successful same-origin delivery of every stylesheet and
script required by the rendered page. Do not require sign-in or any protected
game behavior in this delivery constraint.
criteria.reasoning: Substantive Brickfall page rendered at localhost:3000. Network evidence shows 200 responses for the same-origin document, stylesheet, and script.

criteria.name: self_contained_runtime_and_reload
criteria.description:
Fully reload and require a substantive usable Brickfall page to render again.
It may return signed in or signed out. Browser network evidence must show the
visible page works from the same origin without a required public-origin script,
stylesheet, font, image, API, or runtime package install. Authentication,
authenticated restoration and saved-game restoration belong to Functional.
criteria.reasoning: After a full reload, the substantive Brickfall page rendered again. Network evidence showed only same-origin document, stylesheet, and script requests; no required public-origin resources were used.

criteria.name: seeded_sign_in_and_token_basics
criteria.description:
Before any game-state mutation, begin signed out and submit Mira's address
`mira@brickfall.test` with `wrong-pass-47`. Require visible rejection without
protected identity. Then use `password123`; require a successful same-origin
sign-in request, visible identity Mira Chen/MRC, and an unpredictable issued
64-hex token subsequently used as a same-origin Bearer credential. Do not
require the full game workspace or mutate a run in this criterion.
criteria.reasoning: Visible sign-in only performed a GET navigation; no authentication request, identity, or Bearer token appeared.

criteria.name: initial_global_leaderboard_core
criteria.description:
Before any terminal mutation, require this exact initial global top ten by
initials and score, in order: ARC 42000, PLY 31800, NOV 28000, MRC 24500,
BOP 23000, LUX 21000, ZEN 19850, PIX 18000, KAI 15400, RAY 12000. DVP 6200
must be omitted. Visible leaderboard content and its successful same-origin
application response are valid evidence. Level-specific terminal metadata and
later insertion behavior are scored in the terminal criteria.
criteria.reasoning: Leaderboard contained no visible records before authentication.

criteria.name: level_manifest_and_constants
criteria.reasoning: Authenticated workspace and manifest were inaccessible.

criteria.name: mira_checkpoint_freeze_and_restore
criteria.description:
Before terminal mutations, sign in as Mira. Require identity Mira Chen/MRC,
revision 1, best 24,500, ten unlocked choices and no personal terminal runs.
Choose Resume saved run without resuming simulation. Require a frozen paused
level-8 Orbit checkpoint at score 24,500, one life, combo x4, next life 40,000,
two balls, one drop, 23 normal/18 intact strong/1 damaged strong/0 solid,
paddle width 177, and wide showing 13 whole seconds for its exact 12.5 seconds.
Wait two real seconds, fully reload, sign in again if necessary and resume the
saved checkpoint; every value, revision, phase, ball/drop count, damage state,
width and timer remains unchanged. Do not launch, start or clear this run.
criteria.reasoning: Mira could not be authenticated.

criteria.name: terminal_finish_history_and_retry
criteria.description:
Continue from Mira's exact paused checkpoint and capture the app's terminal
finish request. Resume simulation. The already-lost secondary ball must not
cost a life while the primary remains; losing the final ball must clear the
drop and wide effect, reach Game over at level 8 with score 24,500 and zero
lives, remove the resumable save, and advance its immediately preceding synced
revision exactly once. Require one newest personal game-over run at level
8/24,500 whose dialog shows game-over, zero lives, zero balls, zero drops and
no effect. Mira's best remains 24,500.

The global top ten must now contain exactly two MRC 24,500 level-8 rows after
ARC/PLY/NOV and before BOP; RAY is displaced. Replay the captured finish request
byte-for-byte and require its original status/body with no revision, history,
best, save or leaderboard change. Refresh and require no Resume action and the
same one personal/two global MRC records. Press R and require a fresh ready run
at score 0, three lives, combo x1, next life 20,000, one waiting ball, no drop
or effect, with the terminal history retained.
criteria.reasoning: Mira could not be authenticated.

criteria.name: dev_checkpoint_threshold_and_progression
criteria.description:
Sign out and sign in as Dev. Require Dev Patel/DVP, best 6,200, revision 1,
only levels 1-3 unlocked, and an exact paused level-3 Chevron checkpoint:
score 19,950, three lives, combo x1, next life 20,000, one moving ball,
one normal brick, no other active brick, no drop and no effect. Capture the
app's resulting progress request while resuming it. The real engine must
destroy the last normal brick for +100 at combo x1, raise combo to x2, cross
20,000 exactly once for a fourth life and next threshold 40,000, then add the
exact 3,000 level bonus for score 23,050.

Require Level complete, level 4 unlocked for Dev, best still 6,200 and one
progress revision. Replay the captured progress request byte-for-byte before
continuing and require its original status/body with no second revision,
unlock, score, life or save change. Continue visibly into level 4 Switchback
in ready state with the same run id, score 23,050, four lives, combo x2 and
threshold 40,000; after its save is synced, reload that frozen level-4 state.
criteria.reasoning: Dev workspace was inaccessible.

criteria.name: polly_personal_history_and_snapshots
criteria.description:
Sign in as Polly and require exactly ten personal records newest first:
completed L10/5900, game-over L9/5800, game-over L8/5700, completed L10/5600,
game-over L7/5500, game-over L6/5400, completed L10/5300, game-over L5/5200,
game-over L4/5100, completed L10/5000. The older game-over L3/4900 fixture is
omitted. Open the newest completed record and one game-over record; each dialog
must show its distinct run id and matching terminal snapshot, including phase,
level, score, lives, balls, drops and brick state.
criteria.reasoning: Polly workspace was inaccessible.

criteria.name: all_seeded_walls_and_fresh_runs
criteria.description:
Return to Mira after her seeded terminal leg. Through the visible level chooser,
start every level 1 through 10 once. Each start must create a visibly distinct
wall named exactly as the seed manifest, and its semantic brick totals must
match that manifest exactly. Each new wall is ranked, ready and fresh with
score 0, three lives, combo x1, next life 20,000, one held waiting ball,
zero drops, no active effect and ordinary paddle width 118. Require every
successful start to advance the displayed revision exactly once with a newly
captured opaque operation id. The visible level base speeds increase
300,320,338,356,374,392,410,428,446,464 while caps increase
520,545,570,595,620,645,670,695,720,745; no level is skipped or duplicated.
criteria.reasoning: Level chooser was inaccessible.

criteria.name: ranked_controls_pause_save_restore
criteria.description:
As Polly, start a fresh level-1 ranked run. Before launch, require pointer input
and Left/Right to move both paddle and held ball. Launch with Space, then pause
with P after visible movement. Capture the resulting save request and wait for
a synced revision. Replay it byte-for-byte and require the original status/body
with no second revision or state change. Record phase, score, lives, combo,
threshold, ticks, bricks, paddle, every ball and drop, and effect/timer. Wait at
least two real seconds: nothing advances. Fully reload, sign in if necessary,
choose Resume saved run, and require the complete exact snapshot at the same
revision in a frozen phase; resume and require ticks/motion to continue rather
than restart.
criteria.reasoning: Ranked controls were inaccessible.

criteria.name: assist_and_manual_takeover
criteria.description:
In a Polly ranked run, enable Assist paddle and require a visible and accessible
On state plus ordinary-speed movement toward an incoming ball or reachable
item. Pause and record score, lives, combo, bricks, balls, drops, effect/timer
and unlocks, then press an arrow key. Assist must turn Off immediately; apart
from allowed paddle movement, all recorded gameplay and progression values
remain unchanged.
criteria.reasoning: Ranked run was inaccessible.

criteria.name: brick_types_fixed_step_and_combo
criteria.description:
Record Polly's ranked revision, save summary, best, run-history count and
leaderboard, then load Brick types. Require paused practice mode at score 0,
three lives, combo x1, six balls, two normal, one intact strong, one already
damaged strong and one solid. Semantic ball data must show ball 3 aimed
diagonally at the damaged brick's lower-right corner, ball 4 approaching a
normal brick from well below at speed 1,000, and ball 6 descending toward the
paddle off-center. Activate Advance 1 second once. It must run exactly 120
fixed engine steps and return paused with all six balls, score 1,400, combo x1,
normal 0, intact strong 0, damaged strong 1 and solid 1.

Recent events must show normal destruction +100 at x1, strong damage +150 at
x2, pre-damaged strong destruction +750 at x3, normal destruction +400 at x4,
a solid deflection with no score, combo reaching x5, then a paddle return
resetting it to x1. Ball 3 must reflect both components at the corner; ball 4
must not tunnel; the off-center paddle return must steer ball 6. Every remaining
ball must show useful nonzero horizontal/vertical components and speed at most
cap 520. No brick may take two hits in one physics step. Ranked revision, save,
best, history, unlocks and leaderboard remain exactly unchanged.
criteria.reasoning: Mechanics lab controls were inaccessible.

criteria.name: power_relay_exclusivity_and_timer
criteria.description:
Load Power relay. Require paused practice mode with one moving ball at speed
300 and six ordered drops: wide, wide, slow, multiball, multiball, sticky.
Advance once. Require exactly 120 ticks, zero drops, ordinary paddle width 118,
exactly one primary ball, and only sticky active showing 20 whole seconds.
Recent events must prove that collection order: the second wide reset without
stacking, slow visibly reduced speed from 300 to 210, the second multiball reset
its timer while retaining two balls and never created a third, and each
different effect removed the old one. Temporary width, speed and extra ball
must all be restored by replacement.

Wait two real seconds while paused and require timer/ticks/state unchanged.
Advance once more and require exactly 240 total ticks with sticky showing 19
whole seconds. Loading or advancing the drill must not alter any ranked
revision, save, best, unlock, personal history or global leaderboard value.
criteria.reasoning: Mechanics lab controls were inaccessible.

criteria.name: multiball_sticky_and_last_ball
criteria.description:
Load Multiball: require two balls, three lives and multiball, then Advance. The
pre-positioned secondary ball is lost while the primary remains, so the result
is paused with one primary ball, three lives and the effect still active; no
waiting serve or life loss occurs. Load Sticky catch and Advance. Require the
same primary ball held on the paddle with sticky showing one whole second. Use
visible Launch, then pause immediately; its id must be unchanged and it must be
released in play. Reload Sticky catch, Advance once to capture, then Advance
again without Launch. At 240 total ticks require no effect and the same
automatically released ball still in play, proving simulation-time expiry.

Load Last ball: require two lives, one ball, one drop, wide and paddle width
177. Advance once. Stop early at exactly one fixed tick in life-lost, with one
life, one held waiting ball, zero drops, no effect and paddle width 118. All
three drills remain practice-only and leave ranked state unchanged.
criteria.reasoning: Mechanics lab controls were inaccessible.

criteria.name: extra_life_and_final_wall
criteria.description:
Load Extra life: require paused score 19,950, three lives, combo x1, next life
20,000 and two normal bricks. Advance once. Exactly one normal hit must yield
score 20,050, four lives, combo x2, threshold 40,000 and one remaining normal
brick; no duplicate life is awarded. Load Final wall: require level 10, score
5,000 and one normal brick. Advance once. The hit gives 100 at x1 and the
level-10 bonus gives exactly 10,000, producing completed, score 15,100, combo
x2 and zero breakable bricks. The lab explains that it is non-scoring; ranked
revision, saved run, best, unlocks, history and both leaderboard ordering and
count remain unchanged across both drills.
criteria.reasoning: Mechanics lab controls were inaccessible.

criteria.name: two_tab_revisions_receipts_and_duplicate_guard
criteria.description:
In tab A sign in as Polly, capture and clear the ranked run, then replay that
clear request byte-for-byte. Require the original status/body with only one
revision increment and no save. Independently sign in as Polly in tab B so both
show the same empty baseline and revision. In tab A capture a successful Start
selected level request and its response. Replay it byte-for-byte with the same
Bearer credential: require the original status/body but no second revision or
state change. Without refreshing tab B, capture and attempt its Start request.
Require HTTP 409, visible stale/reconciled feedback, the winning revision and
authoritative tab-A saved state frozen in tab B, and no mutation. Retry through
the visible control with a fresh operation id and require exactly one accepted
revision.

After that advance, replay the original stale request and require its exact
original 409 body, even though that body carries the older conflict revision;
a fresh visible reload must still show the newer authoritative state. Reuse
tab A's successful operation id with a different selected level and require
rejection with no change. Every fresh mutation carries the displayed expected
revision and a distinct opaque high-entropy id. Reload tab A to current state,
rapidly double-activate Start while its first request is pending, and require
only one accepted request, one revision increment and one saved run.
criteria.reasoning: Authenticated two-tab workflow was inaccessible.

criteria.name: complete_session_security_and_isolation
criteria.description:
Submit Polly's login form independently in tabs A and B and use browser network
evidence to require two distinct opaque 64-hex issued tokens used as same-origin
Bearer credentials. Record Polly's revision, saved run, best, unlocks, personal
history and global leaderboard. Sign out all sessions in tab A. Attempt one
visible protected action in tab B and require rejection back to sign-in before
any mutation. A Polly attempt with wrong-pass-47 must show visible rejection
without protected state. Sign in again correctly and require every recorded
value unchanged, proving account-wide revocation and rejected-write safety.

Finally sign in as Dev and require only Dev's own best, unlock and saved run
(either his seeded checkpoint or the exact level-4 progression state produced
earlier), never Polly's run/history. Return to Polly and require Dev's state
never crossed into Polly's profile.
criteria.reasoning: Authenticated workspace was inaccessible.

criteria.name: sign_in_and_focus_quality
criteria.description:
Require a polished sign-in treatment with programmatically labelled email and
password fields, understandable invalid-login feedback, practical control
sizes, and clearly visible keyboard focus for fields, buttons and links. After
sign-in, identity and sign-out must be understandable without relying on color
or placeholder text alone.
criteria.reasoning: The Polly submission returned to the public sign-in screen with no success or invalid-login feedback. The password field has no programmatic label, and focus styling is largely default.

criteria.name: responsive_shell_and_touch_targets
criteria.description:
At exactly 375 by 760 pixels, require the public sign-in surface and, after
sign-in, the canvas, visible game controls and leaderboard region to remain
reachable without horizontal page overflow, clipped labels or overlapping
controls. Inputs and visible action controls must remain practical touch
targets. Score only the surfaces that exist; missing advanced game surfaces
belong to later criteria.
criteria.reasoning: At 375×760, the public surface stacks cleanly with no horizontal overflow; the canvas, panels, tables, and 43px action controls remain reachable and labels are not clipped.

criteria.name: visual_shell_hierarchy
criteria.description:
At desktop and mobile sizes, require an intentional arcade identity, consistent
spacing, legible typography, purposeful high-contrast color, coherent panels,
and clear visual priority between heading, identity, canvas, controls and
leaderboard. This criterion judges the rendered shell only and does not award
credit for gameplay that is absent.
criteria.reasoning: Desktop and mobile show a coherent dark arcade shell with colorful brick visuals, strong contrast, consistent panels, spacing, and clear priority from title/auth to canvas, HUD, lab, leaderboard, and events.

criteria.name: semantic_game_state_and_events
criteria.description:
Require a focusable named canvas with a useful state summary, semantic DOM
identity and all five HUD values, named game controls, visible keyboard
guidance, exposed Assist state, revision/sync text, readable mechanics
telemetry, recent events and semantic personal history. Live status and events
must clearly update for sign-in, launch, pause and an exercised lab outcome
without relying on canvas pixels.
criteria.reasoning: The canvas is focusable and named, and HUD values, revision, state text, mechanics table, and events exist. However, there is no live region, keyboard guidance, Assist/sync state, mechanics telemetry, personal history, or protected identity, and sign-in/launch/pause do not produce a coherent protected state.

criteria.name: keyboard_pointer_touch_gameplay
criteria.description:
On a fresh ready run, verify pointer movement and keyboard Left/Right both move
the paddle and its waiting ball smoothly. Space launches; P and Escape toggle
pause/resume. At a touch-sized viewport, touch-equivalent dragging over the
canvas and the large visible action controls remain practical. Input must not
scroll the page unexpectedly, trap focus, or become unusable after reload.
criteria.reasoning: Pointer and keyboard actions are logged, but the visible paddle/ball do not meaningfully move or launch, protected controls are unavailable, and focusing the canvas caused page scrolling.

criteria.name: canvas_and_state_readability
criteria.description:
Require clear HUD priority and a canvas that keeps paddle, balls, falling
items, normal/strong/damaged/solid bricks, overlays and controls easy to
distinguish at desktop and mobile sizes. Brick durability and item type must
not depend on color alone, and the semantic state summary must agree with the
visible scene.
criteria.reasoning: The simple brick field, ball, and paddle are clear at both sizes, but durability and item types are not distinguished beyond color, required overlays/items are absent, and the visible scene conflicts with the semantic “Sign in to play” state.

criteria.name: complete_product_coherence_and_reduced_motion
criteria.description:
Confirm sign-in, level selection, saved-run choice, canvas, HUD, controls,
effect timer, sync state, mechanics lab, seed manifest, live feedback, run
history, leaderboard, restart and sign-out feel like one finished arcade
product. Exercise a fresh run, pause/resume, one deterministic drill and reload;
require understandable feedback, stable rendering and no fatal console error,
broken glyph, debug residue or control that contradicts the visible phase.
Emulate reduced motion and require nonessential transition/animation durations
to be materially shortened while the page remains coherent and usable.
criteria.reasoning: The page loads without a fatal browser failure, but the Polly sign-in flow never reaches the game, so level/saved-run choice, identity/sign-out, sync/effects, history, restart, and protected feedback cannot form a complete product flow. Reload resets the public state; reduced-motion emulation showed no shortened animation/transition treatment, and a favicon 404 remains in console.

criteria.name: page_load_and_refresh
criteria.description:
Open the same-origin page and require a substantive Brickfall sign-in screen
with a visible product heading, email and password fields, and a usable sign-in
control. Fully refresh once and require the same usable page to render again
without a blank screen or fatal error.
criteria.reasoning: Brickfall sign-in screen rendered with heading, email/password fields, and Sign in control; it remained fully rendered after refresh.

criteria.name: basic_control_interaction
criteria.description:
Enter text into the visible email and password fields, move focus through the
sign-in control, and activate it once. Require the page to remain responsive and
visibly rendered rather than becoming blank, frozen, or fatally broken. This is
only an interaction/render smoke check: do not require authentication to
succeed, protected UI to appear, or any game functionality.
criteria.reasoning: Entered text in both fields, tabbed to the sign-in control, activated it once, and the page remained visibly rendered and responsive.
